title: Apply For Your Free Mobility Scooter
summary: Explore mobility scooter support in 10 questions. See possible funding, charitable and lower-cost options—not an application or eligibility decision.

about.body:
Answer ten simple questions about your plans and preferences, then explore possible mobility support routes. The guide is written for readers worldwide, so it does not assume a particular country's benefits or funding system.

Your answers organise the information you see. They do not assess whether it is medically safe to use a scooter, or determine eligibility for any scheme.

steps: Choose the answer that best describes your situation. No names, contact details or medical diagnoses are requested.
Use the options summary to prepare questions for a qualified mobility adviser or an official local support service.

about.disclaimer: This is an independent options guide, not an application. We do not supply scooters or guarantee free equipment, funding or eligibility. Local rules and a professional assessment determine what is available.

stage-1.preAdCopy: Explore support routes and a practical checklist for your next step. No application has been submitted.

public_support.title: Check public or benefit-linked support
public_support.copy: Start with your country's official health, disability or social support service. Ask whether help towards a mobility scooter is available, which equipment is covered and how to request an assessment. Some schemes cover only certain devices or part of the cost. Existing benefits do not automatically mean a scooter is funded.

community_support.title: Ask about charitable and community assistance
community_support.copy: Contact established disability organisations or local charities and ask about equipment grants, donated scooters or help finding a suitable service. Availability, costs and application rules vary. Verify the organisation independently, and do not pay someone who promises guaranteed approval or a free scooter.

loan_or_purchase.title: Compare loans, rentals and refurbished scooters
loan_or_purchase.copy: Ask a reputable local mobility service about equipment loans, short-term rentals and professionally checked refurbished scooters. These options are not necessarily free. Arrange a suitability assessment and a trial before committing, and compare the full cost, battery condition, warranty, repairs and delivery.

options.heading: Your mobility support options
options.intro: All three routes below are worth knowing about. The first one reflects the support you chose to explore—not a decision about your eligibility or which device is safe for you.
steps: Speak to a qualified mobility professional about the right device, a safe trial and any training needed. This questionnaire is not a clinical assessment.
Contact an official service or a verified organisation in your area. Ask what is covered, whether there are costs or waiting lists, and what evidence a real application requires.
Check access, storage, charging, transport and the full ongoing cost with the provider before agreeing to anything.
